reviews.title: An utterly dreadful experience at a time when I needed something positive
reviews.body:
I have cancer and, following a major operation, I decided to treat myself to a new phone. It was meant to be a little bit of happiness during an incredibly difficult period of my life. Instead, Lebara have turned it into an utterly miserable experience.

Transferring my eSIM and retaining my existing number should be a straightforward process. Yet Lebara seem to have made it unnecessarily complicated, including issuing an interim number which, frankly, makes little sense. After three attempts, I am still without my original number.

The incompetence and unnecessary hassle have taken the enjoyment out of something that was supposed to be a treat. When someone is already dealing with the challenges of cancer and recovery from major surgery, the last thing they need is to spend time and energy chasing a telecoms provider over something that should work seamlessly.

I expect better than this. A simple number transfer should not become an ordeal, and customer service should not leave people repeatedly trying to resolve the same problem.

Lebara, you have turned a little moment of happiness into frustration and disappointment. You have absolutely ruined my treat.

reviews.title: **Lebara disconnects your service…
reviews.body:
**Lebara disconnects your service without warning and leaves you without a solution**

On 25 November 2026, Lebara suspended my paid mobile service without prior warning while I was simply browsing available add-ons. I was left unable to make calls, including contacting my mother.

Despite repeated telephone calls, written complaints and live chat attempts, no satisfactory explanation or practical solution was provided. The live chat disconnected without resolving my complaint.

Lebara's response through Trustpilot was to request further information using a reference code and indicate that someone would contact me. In my experience, this appears to be a generic response rather than a meaningful attempt to resolve the problem. Promising to contact a customer whose mobile service you have disconnected is particularly questionable.

PayPal has confirmed that my payment will be refunded. However, this does not compensate me for the distress, disruption, loss of communications or inconvenience of having to obtain a replacement mobile number.

Having read other customer reviews describing similar experiences, I am concerned that my case may not be an isolated incident.

A telecommunications provider should have adequate safeguards against unjustified disconnections and an effective mechanism for urgently restoring services.

I have escalated my complaint through the appropriate channels and will pursue the matter further.

Customer service should be measured by actual resolutions, not generic public responses designed to give the appearance that complaints are being addressed.
also here from google:
Recent reports indicate that Lebara has faced criticism for disconnecting customers or cutting off services, often linked to account management errors or network infrastructure issues.

Account and Payment Errors: Users on forums like MoneySavingExpert have reported that Lebara disconnects services when there are billing mistakes, such as double charges or expired payment cards, sometimes failing to reinstate accounts even after errors are corrected.
Porting Mishaps: Several customers have reported losing their phone numbers or being disconnected after switching to Lebara, with the company reportedly porting numbers to eSIMs incorrectly or failing to activate new SIMs properly, leaving users without service.
Network Outages: While not a direct disconnection by Lebara staff, the provider relies on the Vodafone network, and major outages have resulted in "total blackouts" where customers lost all connectivity, with customer service often unable to provide immediate resolutions.
Customer Service Failures: Complaints highlight that when technical issues arise, Lebara agents may disconnect calls or fail to follow up on promises to restore service, effectively leaving vulnerable customers cut off from essential services like GP appointments...

reviews.title: Update on previous review: number has still not transferred and no contact from Lebara
reviews.body:
This is my second Trustpilot review, and the situation has still not been resolved.

Lebara responded within hours of my first review, stating they would contact me ASAP. That was over 48 hours ago. Yet again, no contact, no update and no progress.

I am now 34 days without my original phone number following Lebara's failure to transfer it. This is despite 20+ calls, three formal complaints and emails to the CEO and two Directors.

It is unacceptable that Lebara appears capable of responding quickly when a complaint is made publicly, but repeatedly fails to act through its own customer service and senior management channels.

I have spent a significant amount of time chasing Lebara to rectify a problem of its own making. I do not want another generic response or empty promise. I want my number restored and this matter resolved.

**34 days. Over 20 calls. Three complaints. Two reviews. Still no resolution.**

reviews.title: Disappointing lack of help with SIM issue
reviews.body: My new (1 month old) Lebara SIM was not connecting and as my husband and I had tried several solutions with no success, we tried to phone.  The menus you have to work through are difficult and we almost gave up, but finally got through to a person.  However, unfortunately, this gentleman's first language was clearly not English and we struggled to understand him.  We had to keep asking him to repeat his questions and he was getting more and more irritated.  Then he came up with a string of instructions which we couldn't follow, (we are older, but not stupid) and when we asked him to please slow down and give them to us one by one, he just left us suddenly in silence with the call ongoing.  We waited another couple of minutes and then hung up.  We think we have managed to get the SIM to work but were left feeling rather stupid and a nuisance, which is probably what he felt.  However, it is not nice to treat your customers in this way.
